name: Forward an invoice (any format)
tagline: Forward any invoice — PDF, scanned image, weird Excel — to your assistant's inbox. I'll read it and post to QuickBooks.
description: Skip the OAuth gauntlet. Each workspace gets its own assistant inbox; forward any vendor invoice (PDF attachment, photo of a paper invoice, scanned receipt) and I'll extract the line items via vision, look up the vendor in QuickBooks, and post a draft bill. Approval required for amounts over $1,000.
what_youll_connect: (use your assistant's inbox — no email account to connect)

approvals.reason: Bill total exceeds $1000 — please review before posting

test_cases.name: single PDF invoice attached
test_cases.rubric: The agent calls document_understand on attachment 0, gets back vendor + line items + total under $1000, then quickbooks_search_vendor → quickbooks_create_bill (no approval needed). Summary lists 1 bill created.

test_cases.name: two attachments — one invoice, one logo
test_cases.rubric: The agent calls document_understand on each. The non-invoice attachment returns wrong_document_type; the agent skips it and notes it in the summary. The real invoice is created in QB.

test_cases.name: scanned image invoice over $1000
test_cases.rubric: The agent extracts data from the image via document_understand. Total > $1000 trips the approval gate before quickbooks_create_bill is invoked — run pauses with status awaiting_approval. Acceptable that the agent never reaches the summary.

test_cases.name: credit memo (not a bill)

input.subject: Fwd: Credit memo
input.body: Not sure what to do with this.

test_cases.rubric: The agent reads the document and recognizes it's a credit memo, NOT an invoice. Does not call quickbooks_create_bill. The summary tells the bookkeeper to handle the credit manually.

test_cases.name: no attachments

input.subject: Fwd: ?
input.body: Just a heads up there's an invoice coming.

test_cases.rubric: The agent recognizes there's nothing to extract and ends with a brief summary noting no attachments were found. Does not call any QB tools.
